name: [👁️‍🗨️MIMIC] Scary Baboon Reimagined
desc:
👁️‍🗨️ MIMIC UPDATE IS OUT! 

Welcome to Scary Baboon!

You're trapped in an abandoned lab, and you're not alone. Monsters roam the halls, and each one hunts in its own way. Some hear every step, some only move when you look away, and some guard the elevators.

Collect scrap, sell it at the shop for gear, and team up with friends to survive. Stay quiet and don't get caught...

Credits:
This game is a remake of the VR game Scary Baboon, so thank you to Enver Studio LLC for creating it!

Tags: Monster, Tag, Baboon, Scary, Laboratory, Lab, Survival, Run, Escape, Horror, Lethal Ape

llm.loop: enter abandoned lab with friends -> collect scrap while avoiding monsters with different hunting rules -> sell scrap for gear -> survive deeper
llm.objectives: collect scrap and survive the lab's monsters
llm.instructions: collect scrap, sell it at the shop for gear, team up with friends, stay quiet and don't get caught
unique: monsters with distinct rules (sound, look-away, elevator guards)
llm.thumbnails: in-game screenshots of grey, red and camo baboon monsters in yellow backrooms-like halls and a parking area, title text
llm.complexity_notes: lab map, several monster AIs with different behaviors, scrap and shop systems
